note: LEADS.md Part L lead L14 (negative results as priors): STRATA_IC_WARM_MB=N reads the NEXT layer's pre-doorbell weights (mixer projections, router; the engine prints their MiB per layer at start) on a side stream while the fused CPU combine waits for the CPU rows, to keep them in the 80 MiB Infinity Cache; N = the cap in MiB per layer. It was never measured where it acts: T-044 found it inert UNDER DEFERRAL (verify.cpp warm_now needs cfuse_on, which STRATA_VERIFY_DEFER_CPU turns off), and the earlier arms (spec 04, a33-a35) ran on bases with reclaim hits or with deferral. The daily preset has STRATA_COMBINE_CPU=1 and no deferral, so cfuse_on holds and the switch should act: PROOF in the engine log, 'strata switch: STRATA_IC_WARM_MB acted' (tools/pancake/switch_report.py); an arm without that line measured nothing. Exact (reads only): the text must be identical to base. PRIOR: the authors' dense decode lost 181 / 136 / 105 against 186 tok/s at 8 / 24 / 40 MB (paper, bandwidth-bound; ours is CPU-wait-bound, so the prior is 'loses or noise'). Screen rule: promote from 0% up, drop if any case is below -3%; confirm bar >= 2%. Stop pancake.service first.
